title: auth.v1 shared definitions
description: Shared definitions for auth.v1 (docs/API_CONTRACTS_AUTH.md, ADR-022). timestamp and authorizationUrl are byte-identical copies of calendar.v1/calendar-common (a contract test asserts it).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 with offset. Instants only (created/updated/synced); never used for dates the student reads.

authorizationUrl.description: Server-built Google authorization URL (state, nonce, S256 challenge inside). Host and path are fixed; the contract tests parse the query.

purpose.description: Flow purpose. v1 has only signin; reauth (ADR-021) and connect (PO-9d) are later additive values.

landing.description: Post-sign-in landing key. A key, never a URL or path: the server accepts no return URL (the exact return path stays in the browser, sessionStorage).

callbackOutcome.description: Closed outcome set appended to the post-callback redirect /signin?purpose=signin&outcome=<code>. Never carries a code, token, email, subject or Google error text.
